sections.title: Practicing the choice
sections.content: erkély ("balcony") is a place you're ON, not in — a szoba has walls around you, but an erkély is open, so it behaves like a surface: az erkélyen. Practice cycling through all three suffixes across a normal evening at home.

items.english: In the morning I'm on the balcony.

items.spanish: Szép új függöny van a nappaliban.
items.english: There's a nice new curtain in the living room.

sections.content: Run through the same three questions every time: is it inside a room or container (-ban/-ben)? Resting on a surface (-on/-en/-ön)? Or is it a person or place you're near (-nál/-nél)? One of the three will always fit.
